context_files.purpose: Independent paper-level audit of what D0 can support and the minimum post-D0 evidence matrix.
Exact CPU candidate under paper-scope interpretation.

system_thesis_interpretation: D0 has near-zero positive paper evidence but high information value: it determines whether later model comparisons would measure action-conditioned structure rather than target leakage or benchmark defects.
graph_delta_interpretation: The proposal correctly stops before models. Publishable evidence begins only after later gold-use, learned-text, same-corpus transport, three-pack post-native, and randomized on-policy gates under separate scope.
loop_delta_interpretation: The common-deck CPU loop identifies instrument geometry only. It does not demonstrate learning from actions because the experience policy and exact controllers are supplied.
claim_delta_interpretation: The non-headline conformance firewall is mandatory. Even a perfect CPU pass cannot be described as learned dreaming, memory utility, developmental growth, or a self-improving flywheel.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract is paper-relevant because any leakage from target construction, realized selection, or scorer truth would invalidate all later baselines. The full probe suite must remain primary, not appendix-only.
acceptance_test_interpretation: These five gates are the minimum validity envelope. A failure is a benchmark result and must not be repaired by target replacement, threshold changes, weaker probes, or a GPU model run.
assumptions: The explicit graph and program learner remain mandatory later baselines.
D0 is reported only as synthetic causal-instrument engineering.
The action-string balance selector is checked at the exact accepted-deck posterior rather than argued from symmetry alone.

open_questions: Does Rohin confirm that this authorization ends at CPU conformance and does not silently promote D0 into a paper or model claim?
